paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文在相关工作中将目标论文归类为基于RF技术的窃听方法之一，指出其受限于振动分辨率不足，但未详细描述或使用其亚毫米级能力。

evidences.evidence_quote: Reference [50] proposes an RFID-based acoustic eavesdropping method that utilizes RFID tags near the target user. These methods [50], [51], [53], [54] suffer from insufficient vibration resolution due to the long wavelength and low packet rate.
evidences.evidence_context: In recent years, researchers have exploited RF technologies (e.g., WiFi, RFID, mmWave) to perform eavesdropping attacks. In particular, [51], [54] rely on WiFi Received Signal Strength (RSS) and Channel State Information (CSI), respectively, to identify specific spoken words. Using Impulse Radio Ultra-Wideband, [53] can separate multiple audio sources (household objects) by vibration detection. Reference [50] proposes an RFID-based acoustic eavesdropping method that utilizes RFID tags near the target user. These methods [50], [51], [53], [54] suffer from insufficient vibration resolution due to the long wavelength and low packet rate.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用论文在介绍基于RF技术的窃听方法时，将[50]列为一种RFID窃听方法，但紧接着指出包括[50]在内的这些方法存在振动分辨率不足的问题。这是典型的普通相关工作总结，未明确描述目标论文的亚毫米级能力，反而给出了限制性评价。
